Fail-closed first-contact sequence for Vector A (existing IDE/agent hosts) and a
thin Vector B path (no public agent markers): detect → auth warn → seat →
prime regenerable vendor directives (+ .zqk/agent_packs) → write
.zqk/agent-runtime/agent_workspace_sync.json → smoke. Does not expand studio ontology
into the community seed.

  Full sync for the current workspace
  zqk.test system agent-onboard
  Headless / appliance (Vector B)
  zqk.test system agent-onboard --headless --format json
  Detect only (JSON)
  zqk.test system agent-onboard --detect-only --format json
  Dry-run plan
  zqk.test system agent-onboard --dry-run --format json

Usage:
  zqk.test system agent-onboard [flags]

Flags:
      --all-vendors        Write directive files for every known vendor (not only detected)
      --detect-only        Only scan workspace markers; skip seat/prime/smoke writes
      --dry-run            Plan stages without seating or writing files
      --force              Overwrite existing vendor directive files (default skips to avoid clobbering)
  -f, --format string      Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --headless           Force Vector B path: prime AGENTS.md only (skip IDE rule forests unless --all-vendors)
  -o, --output string      Write output to file
  -q, --quiet              Suppress non-essential output
      --skip-prime         Skip writing vendor directive files
      --skip-seat          Skip default seating seed
      --timeout duration   Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
      --vendors string     Comma-separated vendor ids to prime (cursor,claude_code,cline,…)
  -v, --verbose            Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
